parsed_json.up:
Select: md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, md.max_phase, dm.mechanism_of_action, dm.action_type, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name
Source: molecule_dictionary md, drug_mechanism dm, target_dictionary td, compound_structures cs
Join: md.molregno = dm.molregno, dm.tid = td.tid, md.molregno = cs.molregno
Filter: md.max_phase = 4, dm.action_type = 'INHIBITOR'
Sort: md.chembl_id ASC, md.pref_name ASC, cs.canonical_smiles ASC, md.max_phase ASC, dm.mechanism_of_action ASC, dm.action_type ASC, td.chembl_id ASC, td.pref_name ASC
